name: 32128 · Port Orange, FL
findings: ZIP 32128 (Port Orange) has 62 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32128 (Port Orange) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32128 (Port Orange) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 28% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 19% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
